common_scale.reference_mass_convention: LEP-only Breit-Wigner Z input of the pinned SMDR1.3 reference, not an asserted tree-level action pole

matched_SM.location: SMDR1.3 explicit reference-observable calibration transported to mu=91.1876 GeV

conventions.published_matching: SMDR1.3 inverse fit to explicit reference observables, followed by an independent forward call at the saved common-MZ point; see calibrated_matching_results.json

CKM.convention: PDG standard three rotations, Eq. (12.3), exactly unitary for these rounded input parameters
CKM.scale_contract: PDG low-energy/global-fit CKM parameters are taken as the calibrated M_Z boundary; no CKM running or joint fit with the matched-parameter table is performed

matched_parameters.authors: Stefan Antusch, Kevin Hinze and Shaikh Saad
matched_parameters.title: Updated Running Quark and Lepton Parameters at Various Scales

CKM_review.authors: A. Ceccucci, Z. Ligeti and Y. Sakai, Particle Data Group
CKM_review.title: CKM Quark-Mixing Matrix
CKM_review.citation: S. Navas et al., Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024) and 2025 update

quark_mass_conventions.title: Quark Masses, Particle Data Group
quark_mass_conventions.scope: Quark masses require a scheme and scale; light quarks are confined and their running masses are not free asymptotic particle poles

SMDR_forward_inverse_calibration.authors: Stephen P. Martin and David G. Robertson
SMDR_forward_inverse_calibration.title: Standard Model parameters in the tadpole-free pure MSbar scheme

SMDR_forward_inverse_calibration.Z_selection: LEP-only reference; this is not a current all-data fit
SMDR_forward_inverse_calibration.metadata: Pinned PDG2025 reference inputs; top pole extraction, hadronic alpha input and perturbative matching remain empirical/theory premises.

matched_SM.location: Eq. (4), PDG 2024 input; all entries at mu=M_Z
